gizmo.title: Gulu la Stop Note
gizmo.description: Ikani ma stop note angapo mu gawo limodzi lomwe limawonetsa cholemba chimodzi pa nthawi, monga Malangizo kapena Zatsopano. Makadi a malangizo, zolemba zam'mbali ndi mawu ogwidwa a m'chimango angaikidwe pamodzi nawo.

configure.title: Chilembo
configure.description: Dzina la gulu lomwe owerenga sikirini amalengeza, monga Malangizo kapena Zatsopano.

configure.title: Zolemba
configure.description: Ma stop note a mu gulu. Makadi a malangizo, zolemba zam'mbali ndi mawu ogwidwa a m'chimango angawonjezeredwenso.
